The data has no counterfactual outcomes, so I estimated the average treatment effect on the control (ATC) by regression adjustment. I fitted a linear outcome model on the treated units using x1–x25. I then predicted each control unit's outcome under treatment and averaged the difference between that prediction and the observed control outcome. The result is 4.11.

Two other estimates came out close to this. A single regression of y on treatment plus the covariates gives 3.91. The raw difference in means gives 4.27.

ANSWER: 4.11
